name: Anata no Seieki wa Sweet na Aji♪ ~Saimin Communication?~
original_name: アナタの精液はスィートな味♪ ～催眠コミュニケーション?～
source:
Ever since I met that strange cat, my life has changed. 

"Don't you want to do everything you've ever fantasized... to those two girls?" 

Suddenly the cat licked my face. I thought it was crazy, but... those girls. 
They were so beautiful. And as the cat said, they were my willing lovers. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086370.html]DLsite English[/url]]
